scope: This plan lane's additional Dream performance grading and correction, including continuations of this session. This policy grants no new Dream executions and does not alter the separately enabled routine.

The R-3 METHOD and executable contract have outside-lineage approval.

referenceDefaults.note: Reference source defaults, not an assertion about effective runtime overrides. Read dream:control and the governor before any execution.

stop.when: Stop this lane's autonomous performance grading at the first of: the single additional scorecard, the single correction pass, or the fixed deadline. Do not create another initial baseline or restart these counters in a continuation.
stop.success: The complete independently checked follow-up demonstrates a new ordinary automatic measured-downstream-benefit outcome with attributable provenance; preserve the scientific acceptance requirements.
stop.noBenefit: If that outcome remains unknown or broken at the bound, record the exact unmet criterion and stop further grading iterations. Ask the human to choose whether to approve a new scoped usefulness study, change an operating policy, or pause further performance work. No option is pre-authorized by this policy.
stop.prerequisiteFailure: If a prerequisite is still unmet at the deadline, report that exact blocker and stop; lack of proof is not an outcome failure and does not extend the deadline.
stop.mechanism: End any engine loop owned by this lane and leave its durable work-item checkpoint with the measured result and explicit next decision. Do not replace the loop with a recurring poll.

startingObservation.note: Historical starting observation only. Re-read the canonical ledger when consuming the single additional scorecard allowance. This policy is not a passing outcome, a completed experiment, or independent acceptance evidence.
